episodes.synopsis: Haida still doesn't have a job, and doesn't seem interested in getting another one any time soon – which makes Retsuko feel uneasy.
episodes.title: A Prison Called Freedom

episodes.synopsis: With no job, no home and no girlfriend, Haida hunkers down in an internet cafe and, mortifyingly, bumps into an online friend in real life.
episodes.title: Spooky Shikabane

episodes.synopsis: Under the avatar "Fennelope," Fenneko befriends Haida and Shikabane in the online game and sets up a meeting with them in real life.
episodes.title: ANAGURA and Reality

episodes.synopsis: Haida now has to visit Retsuko's parents in two weeks. He'll have to tell them that he's unemployed — unless he can find a job before then.
episodes.title: Restart

episodes.synopsis: A suspicious looking man comes up to Manaka after an OTM Girls' show and asks her about "Aggressive Retsuko." Haida meets up with Tadano.
episodes.title: A Mysterious Messenger

episodes.synopsis: Haida tells her she doesn't have to come, but Retsuko insists on going with him to visit his family home — and it's nothing like what she expected.
episodes.title: A Family Emergency

episodes.synopsis: Retsuko gets approached by a suspicious, but somewhat familiar-looking man who really, really wants her to run for office.
episodes.title: Rage Mission

episodes.synopsis: The day after taking to the stage with Ikari, Retsuko is filled with stress and regret. Time for an epic karaoke session!
episodes.title: Rising to the Challenge

episodes.synopsis: Running for office isn't for the faint hearted — or the empty pocketed. They need to come up with a 3 million yen deposit fast.
episodes.title: A Disconnected World

episodes.synopsis: The pressure almost gets the better of her, but after a quick interaction with Ton, Retsuko picks up the microphone to speak to her potential voters.
episodes.title: The Other Side of Rage
